target.title: fix(reply): degrade gracefully when preflight compaction fails instead of throwing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When preflight compaction LLM call fails (timeout, rate limit, or provider error), the entire reply operation terminates and the Composer is permanently locked in "terminated" state. The user cannot send any new messages without a page refresh.

## Why This Change Was Made

The code comment at agent-runner-memory.ts:206 already states: "Preflight compaction is a guardrail, not a hard dependency". But when compaction failed, the code threw `Error("Preflight compaction required but failed: ...")`, which propagated up and permanently locked the session.

Fix: instead of throwing, log a verbose message and return the session entry unchanged. The agent run proceeds without compaction. The session remains usable.

## Changes

- `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.ts`: Replace throw with graceful degrade (1 file, +12/-6)

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Preflight compaction failure no longer permanently locks the Composer.
**Environment tested:** Node 22.x on Linux
**Steps run after the patch:** Verified compilation with node --import tsx
**Evidence after fix:**

```
$ node --import tsx --no-warnings -e "import('./src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.ts')"
OK
```

**Observed result:** Module compiles cleanly. The `throw new Error(...)` calls are replaced with graceful returns that skip compaction and log the reason instead of crashing the reply operation.
**Not tested:** Live session with triggered preflight compaction failure.

Fixes #100778
